cards.title: Spoon Ferry Flag Clue Show Card

cards.kidDirection: Writer: read the plain line, then show the feeling through ferry clues instead of naming it: ____________________.

cards.visibleCluePrompt: Visible clue: show excitement with a bouncing paper flag, tilted lid dock, or bright napkin sail: ____________________.
cards.objectActionPrompt: Object action: make the spoon ferry tap a cracker dock, nudge a cargo tag, or slide toward the flag: ____________________.
cards.placeSignalPrompt: Place signal: show the lunchbox harbor with a lid dock, napkin tide strip, or cracker pier: ____________________.
cards.characterGesturePrompt: Character gesture: show the ferry helper leaning forward, pointing both hands, or lifting a tiny flag: ____________________.
cards.soundOrTexturePrompt: Sound or texture: add a paper-safe clink, soft rustle, smooth spoon shine, or crisp cracker edge: ____________________.
cards.sentenceFramePrompt: Sentence frame: Instead of saying excited, write: The spoon ferry ____________________.
cards.reviseShowPrompt: Revise show: replace one feeling word with two visible harbor clues and one small action: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: draw the ferry flag, circle one clue, and write one shown sentence: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-out line: make a new spoon ferry sentence that shows a feeling without naming it: ____________________.
